purpose: Models of human fat/adipose distribution for the Rehab Agent digital twin. Kept separate from the main catalog (catalog/repos.json) as requested. Compiled 2026-10-21; repo metadata fetched live from the GitHub API that day.
why_it_matters: A body surface (SMPL/SMPL-X shape, LiDAR scan) is fat + muscle + bone combined. Without a fat layer the twin cannot separate subcutaneous fat from muscle, cannot judge muscle development honestly, and cannot update body composition as training progresses. See docs/accuracy.md red lines.

models.name: TotalSegmentator (tissue-types subtasks)
models.twin_use: Tier A — measured fat compartments from the patient's own imaging. Already in the main catalog as repo #99.
models.notes: Start here. The tissue_4_types subtask additionally splits intermuscular fat out of the muscle class.
models.license: Apache-2.0 (code; model weights/segmentation data carry their own terms - see repo)

models.name: NIH CADLab Body Composition (MIST + 3D nnU-Net)
models.twin_use: Tier A — torso fat/muscle segmentation where CT already exists.
models.weights_availability: downloadable model weights (see upstream README); NIH/NCI terms-of-use PDF in repo
models.notes: Small research release from the NIH Clinical Center / NCI ecosystem — audit before use.
models.license: none found in repo root (checked 2026-10-28; treat as all-rights-reserved)

models.name: vatsatseg
inputs: water-fat (Dixon) MRI: water image + fat image
models.twin_use: Tier A — abdominal VAT/SAT, the metabolically important split. Python port of the TUM SAT_VAT_segmentation tool (Shen et al. 2016).
models.weights_availability: classical (non-DL) segmentation; uses ITK-SNAP for manual correction
models.notes: Abdominal region only. Good reference implementation even if replaced by a learned model later.

models.name: AT_Seg_3DCNN
models.twin_use: Tier A — longitudinal abdominal fat change (training/diet follow-up), ACD 3D U-Net and 3D nnU-Net variants.
models.weights_availability: see upstream; Academic Software License (UCLA) — not permissive open source
models.notes: License is academic-use. Longitudinal design is exactly what progress tracking needs, but check terms.
models.license: none found in repo root (checked 2026-10-28; treat as all-rights-reserved)

models.name: WholeBodyATQuantification
models.twin_use: Tier A — richest compartment taxonomy found; quantification/post-processing code is public.
models.weights_availability: segmentation model available on request (per the 2026 preprint) — not a turnkey download
models.notes: Very recent (2026 preprint, diabetes-research context). High value, low maturity — plan a request/retraining path.

models.name: Adipose_Tissue_Segmentation
models.twin_use: Tier A reference — classical VAT/SAT delineation (Otsu/k-means/fuzzy c-means comparison) from the associated open-access paper.
models.notes: Baseline/reference implementation; useful for sanity-checking learned segmentations.

models.name: Pseudo-DXA
inputs: 3D optical body surface scan (SMPL-standardised mesh, T-pose)
models.twin_use: Tier B — ESTIMATE ONLY. Predicts interior fat/lean/bone distribution from exterior shape (Nature Communications Medicine 2024). Never present as a measurement.
models.weights_availability: on request (Shepherd Research Lab); preprocessing requires Meshcapade SMPL fitting service
models.notes: Conceptually ideal for the camera/LiDAR onboarding path (docs/hardware.md), gated on weights access and validation against real DXA.

models.name: Silhouette fat-depot model (ML4H model zoo)
inputs: front + side body silhouette images (from MRI, photos, or scan projections)
models.twin_use: Tier B — ESTIMATE ONLY. Trained on 40,032 UK Biobank participants vs MRI ground truth (npj Digital Medicine 2022). Silhouettes can be derived from the iPhone LiDAR / camera onboarding scan.
models.code_availability: code path inside the broadinstitute/ml4h repo (model zoo)
models.weights_availability: see upstream model zoo; UK Biobank data itself is access-controlled
models.notes: Strongest published evidence that shape predicts depot distribution — and its VAT/ASAT ratio result shows the limits (R2 ~0.5). Estimates carry population bias; validate per cohort.

models.name: Body fat estimation from surface meshes using graph neural networks
inputs: triangulated body surface mesh (from MRI-derived surfaces, UK Biobank)
models.twin_use: Tier B — ESTIMATE ONLY. Mesh-native version of the silhouette idea; fits a scan-based twin better than 2D silhouettes.
models.code_availability: no verified public code repository found (2026-10-21)
models.notes: Reimplementation candidate: inputs/outputs and mesh resolution (~1000 faces optimal) are documented in the paper.
models.license: n/a - no public code repository (paper-only or closed/licensed model)

models.name: Prediction of total and regional body composition from 3D body shape
inputs: SMPL shape parameters fitted to DXA silhouette + anthropometry (height, waist, hip)
outputs: total and regional body composition masses (DXA-measured ground truth)
models.twin_use: Tier B — ESTIMATE ONLY. Shows SMPL betas carry composition signal once fitted properly, and that waist/hip measures materially improve the fit.
models.code_availability: no verified public code repository found (2026-10-21)
models.notes: Method paper to reimplement against your own DXA/MRI ground truth; do not expect released weights.
models.license: n/a - no public code repository (paper-only or closed/licensed model)

models.name: GHBMC (Global Human Body Models Consortium) human body FE models
outputs: finite-element flesh/fat, muscle, organ and bone behaviour (crash/injury biomechanics)
models.twin_use: Reference only — licensed consortium models. Shows how fat/flesh is represented in high-end FE human models; not usable code for this project.
models.notes: Listed so the team knows the ceiling exists and why we do not build on it.
models.license: n/a - no public code repository (paper-only or closed/licensed model)

models.name: THUMS (Total HUman Model for Safety)
outputs: finite-element soft tissue incl. fat as viscoelastic material, muscle, organs, bone
models.twin_use: Reference only — Toyota's licensed FE human model family (injury biomechanics).
models.notes: Reference for soft-tissue/fat material modelling choices in SOFA-style simulation.
models.license: n/a - no public code repository (paper-only or closed/licensed model)

explicitly_excluded.kind: single body-fat-percentage regressors on anthropometric tables (many small ML repos)
explicitly_excluded.reason: They predict one scalar percentage, not a distribution, from tabular measures. No spatial fat information for a twin.

explicitly_excluded.kind: genetic/GWAS fat-distribution code (e.g. fatdistnGWAS, adiposity MR repos)
explicitly_excluded.reason: Population genetics of fat distribution, not a per-person body model. Out of scope for the twin.
